questions.en: Which country did Prince Henrik, the father of Prince Joachim of Denmark, come from?

timeline.labelEn: Prince Henrik of Denmark, French-born consort of Queen Margrethe II and father of Prince Joachim
timeline.labelDe: Prinz Henrik von Dänemark, in Frankreich geborener Gemahl von Königin Margrethe II. und Vater von Prinz Joachim

questions.notes: The card's 'who has NO German parent' answer is Prince Joachim: his parents are the Danish Queen Margrethe II and the French-born Henri de Laborde de Monpezat (born in Talence). Carl Philip's mother Silvia and Willem-Alexander's father Claus von Amsberg were German.
